text:
julia (PM): quick check — are we aligned on owners for the pricing+metering changes landing in v1.3? need handoff to billing + legal for contract constraints by EOD friday. main items: event schema fields, quota mapping, ratecard mapping

kevin (Eng): i own the metering adapter work. aiming for a PR by wed. will need the final mapping table from product to implement

sara (Billing): can you include a sample usage payload? billing needs unit id + plan tier + any contract flags. pinging @dan for quota mapping

dan (Product Ops): i can do the quota mapping. two quick Qs: 1) how do we represent legacy contracts with min-commit caps, 2) does free tier count toward quota (but not billing)?

julia (PM): for legacy contracts add flags: `contract_type` and `min_commit`. free tier should count against quota but be tagged `free_tier=true` so billing can ignore for invoicing

kevin (Eng): ok will add fields. quick snippet for discussion: ```json
{
  "usage": 12345,
  "unit": "token",
  "plan": "pro",
  "contract_type": "legacy",
  "min_commit": 50000,
  "free_tier": false
}
``` does that cover it?

sara (Billing): looks good. add `tier_effective_date` too so we can handle proration rules

billing-bot: Policy check: new field `contract_type` triggers compliance review. Ticket BILL-421 created -> https://tracker.redwood/ISSUE-421 :information_source:

kevin (Eng): who owns the translation of contract flags into internal billing qualifiers? infra or product?

maria (Legal): legal will only review once billing confirms the final sample. @sara please confirm and i'll queue the contract constraint review

dan (Product Ops): i'll drop the mapping doc in drive and link here (wip): https://drive.redwood/integrations/pricing-mapping. expect finished doc by tomorrow noon

julia (PM): milestones: metering PR wed, billing integration tests thu, legal sign-off fri. if you see blockers call them out here. :eyes:

sara (Billing): adding test matrix items: 1) legacy min-commit enforcement, 2) quota resets + hourly vs daily buckets, 3) free-tier aggregation. i'll add tests to billing CI but need test tokens from eng

kevin (Eng): created test token `ci/test-plan-pro`. creds will be posted to #eng-secrets. will also include a small harness for sample payloads

julia (PM): small ask — if anyone changes the event schema, please add a changelog entry in the repo and ping product. downstream teams parse these events directly and we want to avoid surprises

kevin (Eng): ack — will add a CHANGELOG.md entry in the PR and a brief release note

julia (PM): thanks everyone. once legal signs off i'll send a short stakeholder update. filing a follow-up note after sign-off :mailbox_with_mail:

sara (Billing): noted — will confirm sample + tests by thu morning. :+1:

kevin (Eng): if anything blocks PR i'll flag a rollback plan. tagging @julia to keep on radar

julia (PM): perfect. closing loop for now — will re-open if any blockers come up. :white_check_mark:
